skills.name: cecicela
skills.description: Front door for ceciCela. Use on /cecicela, or when the user is unsure whether to plan a goal (ceci), prove a change (cela), or debug what broke (trouble). Offers a start menu, help, a review of what is remembered, prompt tuning, and feedback; names the skill that fits and hands off.

skills.name: ceci
skills.description: Parent skill that maintains a job graph (brief.md, state.md, log.md), enforces human gates, schedules work, places GPU jobs, and calls /cela for evidence. Invoke with /ceci.

skills.name: cela
skills.description: Run the cela evidence-first engineering protocol. Invoke with /cela. A tool measures whether the task is done; the model does not grade itself.

skills.name: trouble
skills.description: Use on /trouble, troubleshoot, or stuck debug. Also: debug this, incident, let's Bayesian this, four minds, four roles, nothing I try is fixing this.
